audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Ruthless Predator as just 'a stun' and repeatedly tells you to soak his burst with the W shield. Above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s.
audit.why: That single clause inverts the advice: Titan's Wrath is not absorbed, it is deleted, so 'W-shield his early burst' is exactly the wrong instruction against a full-Fury Renekton. The ability is 300 range on 16/14/12/10/8s — the number that tells you when you may step up.
audit.corrected: At 50+ Fury, Ruthless Predator destroys your shield and stuns 1.5s. Step up on its cooldown (16s at rank 1), never into full Fury.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagree with the page's own prose: rows 0 and 3 are Skill though the whys say he out-trades you at 1 and outscales you through 4-5; row 4 is Skill though whys[4] calls it a guaranteed lockdown; row 5 is Renekton though whys[5] says 'first item is a coin-flip'; row 6 is Renekton though whys[6] says you keep him permanently locked down.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Renekton x4 / Nautilus / Skill / Nautilus, matching the prose line for line.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 to Renekton, row 4 to Nautilus, row 5 to Skill, row 6 to Nautilus — both layers, one atomic group, ratings moved with them.

audit.why: His levels 1-3, your level 3 combo, your level 6 Depth Charge, your 2+ item reclaim. Correct ladder; the chart now agrees with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is listed in the itemization block but never appears in the lane text, where the decision actually gets made.
audit.why: Cull the Meek is a 7s, zero-cost AoE that heals him off the whole wave, more when he is above 50 Fury. Without Grievous Wounds your grind never converts.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named in the mid text with the reason attached.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Depth Charge's' as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE, that is Nautilus's real ultimate.

edits.before: Renekton's W stun and fury-empowered autos out-trade you at level 1 when you have only passive root and no combo.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator stuns and, above 50 Fury, destroys your shield outright — at 1 you have only the root to answer.

edits.before: Renekton owns this opening and you have to respect it — his W stun plus a fury-empowered point-click combo out-damages anything you can do before Level 3, and your only engage tool, Q, is a slow projectile he can dash through with his E. Don't try to walk up and short-trade on just your passive root; you'll eat the W stun and lose the exchange. Last-hit at range, hold your Q for when he commits or to disengage, and wait for Level 3 when your Q pull, W shield-burn and E slow finally give you a real combo to punish his cooldowns.
edits.after: Renekton owns this opening and you have to respect it — Ruthless Predator stuns 0.75s, and above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and destroys damage shields, so Titan's Wrath is deleted rather than tanked. Your only engage is a slow projectile he dashes through with Slice and Dice. Don't walk up and short-trade on the root alone; last-hit at range, hold the hook for his commit, and wait for Level 3 when pull, shield-burn and slow finally give you a combo to punish his cooldowns.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still favor him on raw fury damage, so keep farming with E waves and W splash and don't gift him a free Q to dash onto. Six is where the lane turns: Depth Charge is undodgeable and homes through his W stun and E dash, so you can flip a losing trade into a kill or convert a roam into a gank. Layer it — Q pull into passive root, R knock-up, E slow — and he simply can't escape the chain even with his dash on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still favour him on raw Fury damage, so farm with Riptide and don't gift him a hook to dash onto — Cull the Meek heals him off the whole wave every 7s, so buy Grievous Wounds early or the grind never converts. Six is where the lane turns: Depth Charge homes and cannot be dodged, so you flip a losing trade into a kill or convert a roam into a gank. Layer it — pull into root, R knock-up, Riptide — and he cannot escape.

edits.before: Bully you levels 1-3 with W stun and fury-empowered point-click autos before your kit is online
edits.after: Spend 50 Fury on Ruthless Predator to destroy Titan's Wrath and stun you the full 1.5 seconds

notes: The decisive interaction was absent: empowered Ruthless Predator (50+ Fury) DESTROYS damage shields and stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s, so Titan's Wrath does not absorb his burst — it gets deleted. The old 'W-shield his early burst' instruction was actively harmful and is retitled. Anti-heal moved out of the item block and into the mid text with Cull the Meek's 7s uptime as the reason. Chart rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the page's own whys. Packet suspectName 'Depth Charge's' is a false positive.
